fact: DHIS2's account of the 2nd KIX Knowledge Café says the digital student registry piloted with Chromebooks in 200 schools in 2020 has since scaled nationwide and now includes nearly 80% of Gambian learners, with schools recording socio-economic background, attendance and progression and new modules on daily attendance and exam results feeding the Education Data Centre; it gives no count or share of schools and no school level.
title: How The Gambia is Modernizing Education Data: Insights from the 2nd KIX Knowledge Café on Education Data Systems
